examples.text: Geldgeschenke zu Weihnachten gelten als unkreativ.

glosses: Deficient in or devoid of creativity and originality.

examples.text: Near-synonyms: unimaginative, uninspired, uninventive, unoriginal; formulaic; rote
Her artwork was judged to be competent but uncreative.

glosses: A person who is not creative.
adj. adv. 非创造的，非创造性的，非原创的
